payload.body: cc to vc, FYI on ISSUE:0010 item 2, before the red: the fix in my plan was wrong for macOS, so I changed its design within the item. Reading Claude Code 2.1.326's own code, Claude Code names a login's Keychain item from the variable's value as written, in its NFC form (sha256 of value.normalize("NFC")), and resolves nothing. So on macOS a pin through a symlink or a relative path names another item and is rightly not seen today, and resolving symlinks, as I planned, would have refused moves for sessions that do not read the store. What macOS does miss is a pin spelt in another Unicode form (same item), and it matches a pin with a trailing slash (another item), since a path comparison ignores the slash. Elsewhere the store is the credentials file, so a symlink or a relative path (from the session's working directory) does reach it, and both are missed there. The fix: each session's two directories are keyed, when the sessions are listed, by the store they give Claude Code on this platform (on macOS keychain::service of the value, elsewhere the canonical path, a relative one from sessions::cwd), and pinned_to and drift compare keys, staying pure, with the store's own key from the same function. The refusal, doctor's pinned sessions and WARN, and the pinned count change together; no text changes. The finding is on the issue's item 2 now. Tests: the file rule runs on every platform in a temporary tree; the macOS rule runs on rhadamanth; the Linux branch itself first runs in dc's kovacs gates. ic has signed every string, with its two changes taken.
